fixer.title: Cache and coalesce marketplace protected resource discovery

introducer.title: Authenticate Entra ID marketplace API requests via RFC 9728 PRM negotiation

cases.mechanism: Each private-marketplace account revalidation repeated RFC 9728 protected-resource metadata discovery, including sequential authentication-session events and concurrent resolutions, producing redundant network requests on the manifest/account critical path.
cases.symptom: Repeated or concurrent marketplace account revalidation incurred avoidable network latency and request load before the private marketplace manifest could be refreshed.
cases.fixedBehavior: Successful protected-resource metadata is reused for the same full service URL for five minutes, and concurrent cold lookups share one discovery promise. Failures remain retryable, URL/provider changes invalidate the cache, and resource-scoped token acquisition still executes on every account lookup.
cases.evidence: Base line 208 invoked discoverProtectedResource(serviceIndexUrl) for every eligible Microsoft account resolution. WorkbenchExtensionGalleryManifestService.handleMarketplaceAccountAccess calls getAccount on initial private-marketplace bootstrap and again for each Microsoft onDidChangeSessions event; fetchResourceMetadata crosses IRequestService and can issue one well-known GET for root URLs or a path-appended GET plus root fallback for path URLs. The added successful-value check and in-flight request reuse remove repeated discovery while preserving per-resolution token acquisition. Added tests prove sequential resolutions perform one metadata request and three concurrent resolutions coalesce to one.
